text: Meesho's review counts were frozen today: not one of the 351 products seen both yesterday and today gained a review, so there are no fastest movers and today's changes are only new listings, such as party and bandhani sarees, winter sweatshirts, mangalsutra combos and sports gear. For a beginner, home & kitchen and jewellery still look best, with kids' toys and bags close behind.

headline: Women's ethnic: huge demand, but sizes and returns
text: Kurtis lead with the biggest sellers (a ₹295 kurta with about 122,000 reviews and a ₹237 kurti with about 107,000). Review counts did not change for any product since yesterday's run (likely Meesho had not refreshed them), so today shows no review growth; only the list of products changed. Five sarees are new on the lists, including a ₹377 Bollywood georgette party saree and a ₹384 shimmer mirror-work saree, which fits the wedding season running through December. The typical price is about ₹288, but about 9.7% of reviews are 1-star and sellers are concentrated in Gujarat (25) and Rajasthan (11). Sizes, fabric complaints and returns make this hard for a beginner; sarees (no size) are the easier part if you try it.

headline: Women's western: tops lead, winter hoodies joining
text: Tops lead the category, with a ₹162 tank top combo at about 150,000 reviews and a ₹194 women's shirt at about 96,000. Review counts did not change for any product since yesterday's run (likely Meesho had not refreshed them), so today shows no review growth; only the list of products changed. New on the lists are a sweatshirt, a ₹165 tank top and a crop hoodie, and jackets around ₹290 are among the rising newcomers, so winter wear keeps coming in. The typical price is about ₹290 with about 7.4% 1-star reviews, and most sellers are in Delhi (21). Clothing needs sizes, so it is a medium fit; free-size tops are the safer start.

headline: Men's clothing: shirts dominate, high complaints
text: Checked shirts lead (a ₹248 Frekman shirt with about 105,000 reviews), and almost all of the category's reviews come from shirts. Review counts did not change for any product since yesterday's run (likely Meesho had not refreshed them), so today shows no review growth; only the list of products changed. New listings are formal, denim and dotted shirts and a hooded sweatshirt, and hoodies and sweaters are among the rising newcomers ahead of winter. The typical price is about ₹326 and about 11.8% of reviews are 1-star, one of the highest complaint rates, with sellers in Rajasthan, Punjab and Delhi. Sizes and complaints make this hard for a beginner.

headline: Kids & toys: winter sets lead, toys are the easy part
text: Kids' clothing sets lead (a ₹184 baby girl dress with about 89,000 reviews), and on the toy side a ₹96 shape sorter puzzle and a ₹157 bunny plush toy sell well. Review counts did not change for any product since yesterday's run (likely Meesho had not refreshed them), so today shows no review growth; only the list of products changed. The only new listing is a wooden money bank, and wooden gullaks, a dancing cactus toy and kids' sweater sets are among the rising newcomers. The typical price is low, about ₹184, with about 8.5% 1-star reviews, and sellers are mostly in West Bengal, Gujarat and Delhi. Simple toys with no sizes are a good beginner pick ahead of Christmas.

headline: Home & kitchen: decor, diyas and lights still lead
text: Diyas, wallpaper and wall decor lead, with a ₹141 flower diya urli (about 90,000 reviews), ₹144 self-adhesive wallpaper and a ₹91 fridge cover on top. Review counts did not change for any product since yesterday's run (likely Meesho had not refreshed them), so today shows no review growth; only the list of products changed. Six listings are new, including a spice rack, plastic grocery containers, a wooden wall shelf, cotton wicks, an LED rope light and adhesive wall hooks. The typical price is the lowest of all at about ₹157 with about 7.6% 1-star reviews, and Gujarat has the most sellers (12). Light, cheap, no sizes and few complaints make this the best beginner category, and LED lights fit Christmas and New Year.

headline: Beauty: most reviews by far, but brands rule
text: Beauty has by far the most reviews (about 3.5 million across 30 products), led by Ghar Soaps' magic soap, Muuchstac face wash for men and Mamaearth rice face wash. Review counts did not change for any product since yesterday's run (likely Meesho had not refreshed them), so today shows no review growth; only the list of products changed. The only new listing is Pond's light moisturiser, and winter body lotions such as Vaseline are among the rising newcomers. The typical price is about ₹205 with about 8.3% 1-star reviews, and sellers are spread across West Bengal, Haryana and Maharashtra. Most top sellers are brands that need approval to resell, so this is hard for a beginner.

headline: Jewellery: light, cheap and in the middle of wedding season
text: American diamond and rhodium-plated jewellery sets lead (a ₹163 necklace set with about 79,000 reviews), followed by jhumka earring sets around ₹140. Review counts did not change for any product since yesterday's run (likely Meesho had not refreshed them), so today shows no review growth; only the list of products changed. Five listings are new, mostly mangalsutras, a temple necklace combo and a copper bracelet, and a ₹243 chunky mangalsutra and a ₹148 four-piece combo are among the rising newcomers, which fits the wedding season through December. The typical price is about ₹165 with about 7.7% 1-star reviews, and sellers are mostly in Gujarat (15) and Maharashtra (13). Light, cheap, no sizes and few complaints make this one of the best beginner categories.

headline: Bags & footwear: bags steady, Delhi sellers dominate
text: Handbags lead (a ₹251 handbag with about 68,000 reviews and a ₹259 sling bag with about 63,000). Review counts did not change for any product since yesterday's run (likely Meesho had not refreshed them), so today shows no review growth; only the list of products changed. New listings are mostly slippers and flip-flops plus two handbags, and ₹132 bellies and ₹297 sneakers are among the rising newcomers. The typical price is about ₹206 with a low 7.2% 1-star rate, but Delhi has most of the sellers (26 of 39 products), so competition there is strong. Bags need no sizes and are a good beginner pick; footwear needs sizes and is harder.

headline: Electronics: stands and cables fine, earbuds risky
text: A ₹382 wooden Bluetooth speaker and ₹82 phone stands lead, with earbuds and a ₹193 4-in-1 charging cable close behind. Review counts did not change for any product since yesterday's run (likely Meesho had not refreshed them), so today shows no review growth; only the list of products changed. There are no new listings today, and a ₹186 selfie stick tripod and cheap earbuds are among the rising newcomers. The typical price is about ₹325, but about 12.1% of reviews are 1-star, the highest of any category, and sellers are split between Haryana, Delhi and Gujarat. Phone stands and cables are fine for a beginner; earbuds and speakers bring complaints and copy-brand risk.

headline: Health & fitness: pads dominate, small wellness items move
text: Sanitary pads lead (everteen pads with about 197,000 reviews), and ₹68 invisible earlobe patches are the biggest non-branded seller. Review counts did not change for any product since yesterday's run (likely Meesho had not refreshed them), so today shows no review growth; only the list of products changed. Seven listings are new, mostly sports items such as a cricket helmet, a badminton racket, footballs and wind balls, plus an ear cleaning kit and sanitary pads. The typical price is about ₹214 and about 11.5% of reviews are 1-star, and sellers are mostly in Delhi, Punjab and Uttar Pradesh. Branded pads need approval, so small items like earlobe patches and simple sports gear are the beginner-friendly part.

headline: Wall shelves: steady, small and beginner-friendly
text: Only 20 products were read from this single list, with about 83,000 reviews in total. The top listing is still a ₹91 wall-mounted mobile holder (about 27,500 reviews), followed by ₹193 self-adhesive steel bathroom shelves and a ₹313 plain wooden shelf. Review counts did not change for any product since yesterday's run (likely Meesho had not refreshed them), so today shows no review growth; only the list of products changed. The typical price is about ₹181 with a low 7.1% 1-star rate, and sellers are mostly in Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan and Gujarat. Shelves need no sizes and get few complaints, but wooden ones are bulky to ship, so light adhesive shelves are the easier start.

LED string and rope lights around ₹150 to ₹180 (Christmas and New Year)
American diamond jewellery sets and mangalsutra combos around ₹140 to ₹250 (wedding season)
Self-adhesive wallpaper, wall stickers and wall hooks around ₹100 to ₹150
Sling bags and printed tote bags around ₹150 to ₹260
Self-adhesive bathroom shelves and wall mobile holders around ₹90 to ₹200
Simple toys and wooden coin boxes around ₹100 to ₹160 (Christmas)

Avoid for now: men's shirts (11.8% 1-star reviews), earbuds and speakers (12.1% 1-star and copy-brand risk), branded beauty and sanitary products that need brand approval, and size-heavy clothing like kurtis with nearly 10% 1-star reviews.
